text: W2-SEJT resolution. Canonical signature = b7c2ecb570 4-param 'int lichen_sha256(const uint8_t *input, size_t inlen, uint8_t *output, size_t outlen)' + 117fa9ec8c per-stage error docs (4th param is an output-bounds input: -ENOMEM if < TC_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE; reverting to 3-param would undo the q3iy.25 P2 security fix). Files changed (6): lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_util.h + firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_util.h (decl 3->4-param, merged doc), lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_util.c (impl restored to 4-param w/ bounds check), lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_rx.c:194 + lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_identity.c:146 (3->4-arg, sizeof(hash)), lichen/tests/util/main.c (4-arg forms + restored test_sha256_rejects_small_output -ENOMEM test dropped by the merge). NOTE: description said impls were 4-param and lora_l2_identity was 4-arg; working tree actually had uncommitted wrong-direction reverts (l2 impl 3-param, lora_l2_identity 3-arg); HEAD a469a301f4 itself carries the bad merge (3-param headers + 4-param impl + mixed callers). VENDORED COPY NOTE: firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/ is referenced by NO CMake build (bridge CMakeLists compiles only src/main.c and adds the lichen module l2 dir to the include path); vendored lichen_util.c/ipv6_addr.c syntax-clean after the header fix, lora_l2.c residual errors are borrowed-config artifacts only (0 sha256-related); tree left uncompiled = drift risk, recommend deleting or wiring it in a follow-up. Task-specified cmake+ctest path for tests/util is NOT host-runnable (twister ztest app, find_package(Zephyr) fails w/o west-registered board env; native_sim-on-Mac unreliable per AGENTS.md) - standalone harness used instead, actual suite expectations executed unmodified.
